messages:
maya: @vendor_ops got an email — forwarder can ship 40 H200s into FRA 5 days early if we accept a 3% early-window surcharge and split AWB fees. RMA cutoff shifts to 2025-04-12 for these lanes. Is this acceptable to commit? Need decision by EOD.

vendor_ops: FYI here's the exact clause they want: "early window surcharge = 3% of invoice; earliest acceptance = 5 business days prior". AWB will be split 50/50 unless we absorb. Carrier: AirFast, AWB: AF123456789

trent: How many of the 40 are reserve vs topoff? if all are topoff we can use them; if reserves we'd rather keep our buffer for US pool. ETA to DC? is FRA final or transload to AMS?

liam: We currently have 12 H200s allocated to EU pool, usage trend shows we burn ~8/week. 40 early would help, but storage at FRA costs €250/unit/week. Also RMA cutoff move to Apr12 means returned DOA claims processed later — impacts warranty window by ~3 days.

maya: @trent it's 28 topoff / 12 reserve. FRA is final but can crossdock to AMS next day. Storage fees are negotiable; vendor offered one free week.

vendor_ops: Carrier will accept consolidation at FRA for a €15/pallet handling. If Redwood absorbs surcharge total extra = ~€9,360 (3% of invoice). We can push invoice split to net-30 with early acceptance to reduce cashflow hit.

trent: Quick calc: invoice = €312k -> surcharge €9.36k -> per-unit surcharge ≈ €234/unit. If we accept, recommend absorbing surcharge for 28 topoff only = €6,552 and credit reserves.

liam: Ops concern: bringing 28 into cluster means we need to schedule staging window; eng-infra needs 48 hours notice to configure racks and burn-in. Can we get guaranteed hold at FRA for 48h? will vendor confirm?

vendor_ops: Carrier confirmed 48h hold for free if we sign amendment. Clause: "48h free hold at FRA with holding manifest AF-HOLD-48". They require signature by 18:00 UTC.

maya: Ok propose: accept early shipment for 28 topoff, absorb surcharge pro-rated, insist vendor covers reserve units' storage beyond 7 days. I'll draft amendment and loop legal. anyone object?

trent: :+1: proceed. pls cc @finance on invoice split plan.

liam: :+1: confirm rack scheduling after amendment signed.

logistics-bot: [AUTO] Created task INF-8437: Schedule FRA crossdock + staging (28 units). Assigned to @liam. ETA 2025-04-02.

maya: Thanks, I'll send amendment now and ping when signed.
